name: InkMonk Research MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for InkMonk Research. Exposes catalog discovery, pricing calculation, Turnitin verification consultation, and direct contact tools for AI agents.

tools.name: get_service_catalog
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive catalogue of academic research services in English and Hindi with turnaround times.

tools.name: calculate_quote
tools.description: Calculate exact quotation for research paper, thesis, book writing, and Turnitin plagiarism check using central server pricing rules.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get verified contact details, founders profile, and Kolkata office address of InkMonk Research.
